description: Candidate mappings from DEN.C11 local concepts to LOINC, transcribed from the source data dictionary without asserting exact equivalence.

text.div: The workbook supplies LOINC 20570-8 as a Best Fit candidate for rising, falling, and normal/stable hematocrit options. This code identifies a hematocrit measurement and is not the directional status itself; mappings are relatedto candidates pending review.
